items.title: Furious Eckert not impressed with Southampton mocking as Middlesbrough boss confronts Azaz in fiery Spygate clash
items.summary: TONDA ECKERT angrily cleared away a box of tissues left on the press conference table to goad Middlesbrough boss Kim Hellberg after Southampton’s 2-0 victory.
